title: Weekly reminder schedule pinned by learning tests
task: Reminders are configured as strings like `mon 09:30` and `fri 17:00`. Implement `Next(spec string, after time.Time) (time.Time, error)` in package `remind` returning the first occurrence strictly after `after`, in the same location as `after`. We have been bitten by `time.Parse` layouts and `time.Weekday` arithmetic before, so pin the standard-library behaviour you rely on in tests of their own, and keep every test repeatable no matter what the wall clock says.
